So a ruling that parks nothing, whether a proposed Decision or ANY DesignRule, reads as success","source":"fix program R-S2; the observation fact:governed-by-accepts-a-parks-ruling-on-a-proposed-decision-and-nothing-says-it-parks-nothing-2026-09-29","statement":"RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-29, fix program R-S2.

① OBSERVED, installed 0.74.0, isolated scratch store:
- An Artifact is flagged orphan_node.
- `governed_by(art, dec:proposed, ruling: parks)` replied with the stored edge {ruling: parks} and nothing more; the Artifact was STILL flagged, and swept.parked was [].
- Accepting a ruling and parking under it: parked, flag gone.
- SECOND INSTANCE, measured the same way: `governed_by(art, rule:enforced-DesignRule, ruling: parks)` also replied with success and parked nothing. The reader reads only Decisions, though the tool's description opens "Link a node to the Decision or DesignRule".
- Code on origin/main 6329079 matches: capture.rs governed_by_on runs graph.rs governed_by, which is a bare create_edge, and returns the edge.
EXPECTED: the description's own sentence, "The ruling must be an ACCEPTED Decision".
NOT AFFECTED: all 264 parks edges in reflow2's own committed design point at accepted Decisions, so no existing record is silently ineffective.

② PRECEDENT, searched in child-reflow2 and flo2:
- the observation fact of 2026-09-29 (found while building #629);
- heal.rs's own comment, written with #227 (2026-08-17), says "Refusing that keeps the two-sided shape honest". The refusal was put in the READER (is_parked skips it), and no write-time check was ever added;
- #625 made every parks READER name the rule (PARKING_READERS), and none of that reaches the writer.

③ CANDIDATES:
(a) The condition is validated only where it is read, and the writer never asks.
(b) Deferred effect is intended: draw now, take effect when the owner accepts. The fault is then only that the reply is silent.
(c) The description is wrong and should not promise acceptance.
(d) The observation is wrong, and another reader honours proposed rulings.

④⑤ MEASURED:
- (d) is refuted: one predicate, is_parked, is shared by every reader, pinned since #625.
- (c) is refuted: the reader enforces exactly what the description says.
- (b) and (a) are BOTH true. Deferring effect to acceptance is legitimate, since settling the ruling is the owner's act and may come after the agent draws the edge, but NOTHING tells the writer.
- For a DesignRule target the effect is not deferred but IMPOSSIBLE, because no status change will ever make the reader honour it.

⑥ CLASS: a validity condition checked only by the reader, while the writer reports success regardless. The write's reply says what was STORED, never whether it TAKES EFFECT.
FIX AT THE CAUSE:
- the writer asks the same single predicate the readers use;
- a Decision ruling that is not yet accepted is RECORDED, and the reply says plainly that it parks nothing until the ruling is accepted, and how to settle it;
- a target that can never park (not a Decision) is REFUSED, because recording it would store a claim no reader will ever honour.
Pinned by a test over the ruling states × every parks reader: the writer's stated effect must equal what the readers do.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: the generic create_edge/create_edges path can still write a parks edge with schema checks only, by design (its description says so).
